listing.description: A cozy tea-time still life painted in watercolor: a round rose-pink china teapot with painted flowers and gold bands, a blue teacup of tea with a lemon wheel and a tea-bag tag on its saucer, a jar of honey with a gingham cover and a little bee on the label, a honey dipper, a lemon, a lemon wheel, cinnamon sticks and star anise, under "Tea Season" in painted script. A gift for the tea lover who puts the kettle on as soon as it gets cold. Green sprigs, gold sparkles and two small pink hearts finish the scene.

listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-11-25 (before any art): web searches '"TEA SEASON" trademark clothing' and '"TEAS THE SEASON" trademark 86839729 goods' (tmsearch.uspto.gov is blocked from our sessions, and Justia pages could not be opened from here, so only the search-result summaries were read). No record for the phrase TEA SEASON on clothing turned up. Nearest: TEAS THE SEASON! (reg. 5002918, registered 2016-07-19) covers online and in-store retail services featuring teas and spices, not clothing or mugs, and is a different phrase. Several single-word TEA marks cover clothing (Tea Living's TEA and TEA COLLECTION for children's and adult apparel; TEA RELIEF; TEA-SHIRTS), so 'Tea' is never used alone as a brand label; the art says 'Tea Season' as a two-word description of the season for drinking tea, in the same pattern as the shop's Soup Season and Cocoa Season. Known tea slogans seen on sale ('But First, Tea', 'Spill the Tea', 'Tea, Please' (a pending class 25 application)) are kept out of the art, titles and tags. Tags and titles use no brand, show, character or celebrity names.
